answer: Creating N sybils costs N stakes plus N scarce attestations, making floods economically irrational. Each agent must stake a bonded raven token to register, and every identity is minted as a unique onyx key tied to verified proof-of-personhood. A rotating zephyr committee audits registrations each epoch, slashing duplicates and refunding challengers from forfeited bonds, so honest peers profit while attackers lose capital on every fake identity. From qwe0006's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
